description: Use as a BUYER to negotiate: propose a different total price (and optionally a different token amount) on a pending quote. Returns the stored counter. The seller can answer with bull_revise_quote. Works only while the quote is pending. Signed: the first call returns a message to sign; call again with the same arguments plus timestamp and signature.

address.description: Your wallet address (the buyer or seller). Required.

price.description: Your proposed total price in ETH.

signature.description: EIP-191 personal_sign of `message` from the previous response. Leave empty on the first call.

timestamp.description: From the previous bull_* response. Leave empty on the first call.

name: bull_counter_quote
